test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Atul sells goods to a customer at a profit of P%. If the cost price of the goods for the customer is Rs. 1,50,000 and Atul makes a profit of Rs. 30,000, then what is the value of P?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = Rs. 1,50,000

Profit = Rs. 30,000

**Formula Used:**

Profit % (P) = (Profit / CP) × 100

**Calculation:**

SP of Atul = CP of Customer = Rs. 150000

Atul CP = 150000 - 30000 = Rs. 120000

Profit % (P) = (30,000 / 1,20,000) × 100

⇒ P% = (30,000 / 1,20,000) × 100

⇒ P% = 25%

**The value of P is 25%.**
